user.title: Divoom Times Gate
user.description: Pick your device (auto-discovered on your network) or type its IP, then enter the LocalToken shown in the Divoom app under Device settings.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Times Gate
reconfigure.description: Update the device's IP address, LocalToken, or refresh interval. The integration reloads with the new settings.

starter.title: Fill the screens
starter.description: Pick what to put on the five screens. Found: {found}. Whatever you pick is written once as ordinary screen configuration, so you can edit any screen afterwards and nothing overwrites it. You can also leave the screens empty and configure them later under Configure.

menu_options.starter_energy: Energy: price, house power, battery, solar and a day-ahead price graph
menu_options.starter_climate_air: Climate and air on one screen: thermostats, temperature, humidity and CO2
menu_options.starter_presence: Presence on one screen: who is home, the alarm, and open doors and windows
menu_options.starter_calendar_clock: Calendar and clock on one screen, alternating

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Times Gate
reauth_confirm.description: The Times Gate at {ip_address} rejected the stored LocalToken. This happens after you re-pair the device in the Divoom app. Enter the current LocalToken shown in the Divoom app under Device settings.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device, or the LocalToken was rejected. Check the IP and token.
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected this LocalToken. Check the value shown in the Divoom app under Device settings.

abort.already_configured: This Times Gate is already configured. Its IP address and token were updated in place.
abort.reauth_successful: Reauthentication successful. The new LocalToken was saved.
abort.wrong_device: The device at this IP is a different Times Gate (MAC mismatch). Add it as a new device instead.

init.title: Times Gate configuration
init.description: Editing layout **{preset}**. Pick a screen to change what it shows. Every step saves on its own and reloads the device.

screen_template.title: Fill from a template
screen_template.description: Fill screen {screen} from what Home Assistant already knows. Only templates that found something are listed. What they write is ordinary configuration from then on, so you can edit it afterwards and nothing regenerates it.

screen_sensors.title: Sensors
screen_sensors.description: Screen {screen} draws up to {max} entity states in a grid. Pick the entities in the order you want them, then a colour theme.

screen_face.title: Native face
screen_face.description: Screen {screen} shows one of the device's own faces instead of anything from Home Assistant. The list holds your favorites from Favorite faces.

screen_yaml.title: Edit as YAML
screen_yaml.description: Screen {screen} of layout **{preset}**, currently {current}. Give it a single page, or a list of pages that rotate by each page's 'duration'. See the README for the page schema.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: A layout is a named set of five screens, so one device can carry an energy view, a night view and whatever else. Editing **{preset}**: {screens}.

menu_options.layout_copy: Save these screens as a copy

layout_switch.title: Switch layout
layout_switch.description: Pick the layout that drives the device. All five screens change at once. Currently **{preset}**.

layout_copy.title: Save as copy
layout_copy.description: Save the five screens of **{preset}** under a second name, and continue editing the copy. The original is left alone.

layout_delete.title: Delete layout
layout_delete.description: Remove a layout and its five screens. The last remaining layout cannot be deleted. Currently editing **{preset}**.

energy.title: Build energy screens

energy_screens.title: Pick the energy screens
energy_screens.description:
Choose which screens to write to {preset}. Only screens the discovery can fill are listed. A screen you clear is written as a blank slot you can fill by hand, and the other screens keep their place.

{screens}

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Refresh interval; the Independent Display preset Home Assistant draws over (pick one with static faces, or a blank one, so native faces do not reload under the overlay); and favorite faces, a mapping with 'overall' and 'per_screen' lists of name plus clock_id.

data.dashboard_base: Independent Display preset to draw over

faces.title: Favorite faces
faces.description: Favorites are the native device faces offered under Display source and under a screen's Native face.

faces_pick.title: Pick faces
faces_pick.description: The device reported {count} faces. Overall faces drive the whole display at once; per-screen faces are offered on a single screen. The order you pick them in is the order the dropdowns show. If the device did not answer, type a numeric face id to add it anyway.

faces_yaml.title: Edit faces as YAML
faces_yaml.description: Two lists, 'overall' and 'per_screen', each holding entries with a name and a clock_id. Use this to rename a face or to add one the device did not report.

advanced.title: All layouts
advanced.description: Every layout as one mapping of name to a list of five pages. Use this to paste a set of screens in, copy one out, or add a layout. Currently editing **{preset}**.

error.preset_name_required: Give the new layout a name.
error.preset_name_taken: A layout with that name already exists.
error.preset_last: This is the only layout left, so it cannot be deleted.
error.too_many_entities: A screen holds at most 8 entities.

abort.no_faces: No favorite faces are configured. Add some under Favorite faces first.
abort.no_starters: No template found anything to show on a single screen.
